title: Split media.rs into pure logic and persistence
description: Refactor media.rs to separate pure logic (MIME sniffing, image resizing, blurhash generation, EXIF stripping) from persistence (sqlx queries, file storage). Add missing GIF frame bomb protection (500-frame limit from gaja). The pure logic becomes a thin wrapper around fieldwork::media once that module exists.
close_reason: Already split: pure logic lives in fieldwork::media_processing (MIME sniffing, image processing, GIF bomb protection). smallhold media.rs is only handlers + persistence.
